simple.meaning: נוּא (nûwʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to refuse , forbid , dissuade , or neutralize.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 9 times in Numbers, Psalms, beginning at Numbers 30:6. The surrounding contexts include land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נוּא (H5106) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נוּא (nûwʼ) / H5106 is traced through Numbers 30:6, Numbers 30:9, Numbers 30:12, Numbers 32:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to refuse , forbid , dissuade , or neutralize
definitions.usage: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.
definitions.full: H5106. nu [ נוא ] verb hinder, restrain, frustrate (Arabic () (or ) rise with difficulty, rise against one (Frey), III. contend with , Lane 2861 ); — Qal Imperfect 2masculine plural תנואון Num 32:7 Kt, but read Hiph`il (so Qr), compare Di. Hiph`il Perfect הֵנִיא Num 30:6 , etc.; Imperfect יָנִיא 30:9 , יָנִי Psa 141:5 , תְּנִיאוּן Num 32:7 Qr; — 1 restrain, forbid (performance of vow), followed by accusative of person Num 30:6 (twice in verse); 30:9 ; 30:12 ; frustrate (device of people), subject ׳י , followed by accusative of thing, Psa 33:10 (|| הֵפִיר ); refuse 141:5 ((text dubious see Che). 2 restrain, make averse the heart (accusative) Num 32:7 (followed by מֵעֲבֹר ), 32:9 (followed by לְבִלְתִּיבֿאֹ ).

occurrences.englishText: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
“If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
“But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.
Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing.
Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness;
